story.text: 전주천에 노을이 내려앉았다. 하루의 끝, 우리는 강변 벤치에 나란히 앉았다.
story.reading: jeon-ju-cheon-e no-eul-i nae-ryeo-anj-at-da. ha-ru-ui kkeut, u-ri-neun gang-byeon ben-chi-e na-ran-hi anj-at-da.
story.en: Sunset settled over Jeonjucheon. At the end of the day, we sat side by side on a bench by the river.

story.text: '오늘 하루도 잘 마무리했네.' 하늘이 물끄러미 강물을 보며 말했다.
story.reading: 'o-neul ha-ru-do jal ma-mu-ri-haet-ne.' ha-neul-i mul-kkeu-reo-mi gang-mul-eul bo-myeo mal-haet-da.
story.en: "We wrapped up today well too." Haneul said, gazing blankly at the river.

story.text: 저녁 바람이 선선하게 불어왔다. 낮의 소란스러움은 잦아들고, 사람들의 발걸음도 느려졌다.
story.reading: jeo-nyeok ba-ram-i seon-seon-ha-ge bul-eo-wat-da. naj-ui so-ran-seu-reo-um-eun ja-ja-deul-go, sa-ram-deul-ui bal-geol-eum-do neu-ryeo-jyeot-da.
story.en: The evening breeze blew in, cool and pleasant. The day's noise had quieted, and people's footsteps slowed.

story.text: '그동안 여기저기 데려가 줘서 고마워.' 내가 먼저 말을 꺼냈다. 그는 잠시 말이 없었다.
story.reading: 'geu-dong-an yeo-gi-jeo-gi de-ryeo-ga jwo-seo go-ma-wo.' nae-ga meon-jeo mal-eul kkae-naess-da. geu-neun jam-si mal-i eop-seot-da.
story.en: "Thanks for taking me around all these places." I spoke first. He was quiet for a moment.

story.text: '뭘 그런 걸로.' 그가 무심히 답했다. 그러나 옆에 앉은 어깨는 평소보다 조금 더 가까웠다.
story.reading: 'mwol geu-reon geol-lo.' geu-ga mu-sim-hi dap-haet-da. geu-reo-na yeop-e anj-eun eo-kkae-neun pyeong-so-bo-da jo-geum deo ga-kka-wot-da.
story.en: "It's nothing." He answered indifferently. And yet, the shoulder beside me sat a little closer than usual.

story.text: '너랑 있으면 이상하게 편안해.' 내가 무심코 중얼거리자, 그가 살짝 고개를 돌려 나를 봤다.
story.reading: 'neo-rang iss-eu-myeon i-sang-ha-ge pyeon-an-hae.' nae-ga mu-sim-ko jung-eol-geo-ri-ja, geu-ga sal-jjak go-gae-reul dol-lyeo na-reul bwat-da.
story.en: "It's strange — I feel so at ease when I'm with you." I murmured without thinking, and he turned his head slightly to look at me.

story.text: '나도.' 짧은 한마디였다. 그러곤 다시 강물로 시선을 돌렸다. 무뚝뚝한 옆모습이 오늘따라 유난히 편해 보였다.
story.reading: 'na-do.' jjalb-eun han-ma-di-yeot-da. geu-reo-gon da-si gang-mul-lo si-seon-eul dol-lyeot-da. mu-ttuk-ttuk-han yeop-mo-seub-i o-neul-tta-ra yu-nan-hi pyeon-hae bo-yeot-da.
story.en: "Me too." It was a short reply. Then he turned his gaze back to the river. His blunt profile looked unusually at ease today.

story.text: 노을이 완전히 저물 때까지, 우리는 별다른 말 없이 그저 나란히 앉아 있었다. 그것으로 충분한 하루였다.
story.reading: no-eul-i wan-jeon-hi jeo-mul ttae-kka-ji, u-ri-neun byeol-da-reun mal eop-si geu-jeo na-ran-hi anj-a iss-eot-da. geu-geo-seu-ro chung-bun-han ha-ru-yeot-da.
story.en: Until the sunset faded completely, we just sat side by side without much to say. That alone was enough to make it a good day.

words.example_en: I take a walk in the evening.
I feel at ease when I'm here.

sentences.en: Shall we wrap it up now?
